description: React hook and provider for syncing state and events across browser tabs using the BroadcastChannel API.
rules: Import useBroadcastChannel (or BroadcastProvider) from 'react-broadcast-sync'; it is for same-origin browser tabs only, not server or cross-device sync.
Message deduplication is by message ID, not content. deduplicationTTL defaults to 5 minutes; cleanupDebounceMs defaults to 0.
Do not give two tabs the same sourceName: a tab ignores messages from its own sourceName.
keepLatestMessage keeps a single latest message across all types, not one per type.
Keep cleanupDebounceMs smaller than cleaningInterval, otherwise cleanup can be postponed indefinitely.
Anonymous telemetry is on by default; pass telemetry: false to disable it.

messages is a log of received messages, not current state. To sync state, update local state and call postMessage in the same handler, and apply incoming messages with onMessage. Never call postMessage from a useEffect on state that is also set from incoming messages: it creates a ping-pong loop.

Messages are not replayed to tabs opened later, and keepLatestMessage does not change that. For initial state, have the new tab post a 'state-request' message and let an existing tab reply with the current state.
